quarterly_data.signal: Montage Technology announced on September 29, 2026 that its upgraded DDR5 clock driver chip (CK01P) has entered mass production, providing clock-driving support for next-generation client memory modules. CK01P complies with the JEDEC DDR5CKD01 clock driver specification, targets next-generation client modules such as DDR5 CUDIMM, CSODIMM, CQDIMM and CAMM, and supports data rates up to 9200 MT/s; it offers three clock-driving modes (single PLL, dual PLL and PLL bypass), uses a zero-phase-delay clock-driving architecture with per-channel programmable delay, and can lower power by turning off unused clock outputs. Besides CKD chips, Montage offers SPD, PMIC and other client memory-interface and module companion chips. President Stephen Tai: as AI applications accelerate into client devices, client platforms need more memory bandwidth, signal integrity and energy efficiency, pushing DDR5 modules toward higher data rates and lower power, and the CK01P mass production comes at the right time.
quarterly_data.figure: CK01P up to 9200 MT/s; mass production
